title: "Savings Simulation"
format: html
execute:

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(highcharter)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

# Load raw Excel file
df_raw <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(read_excel("data/M016081.xlsx", sheet = "M016081", col_names = FALSE)))
df_income_raw <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(read_excel("data/LFR2024_SectionC.xlsx", sheet = "C4", skip = 6)))

# Rename and clean income data
colnames(df_income_raw)[1:3] <- c("AgeGroup", "GrossMonthly", "PMETs")

df_income <- df_income_raw |>
  filter(str_detect(AgeGroup, "^\\d+\\s*-\\s*\\d+|60 & Over")) |>
  select(AgeGroup, GrossMonthly) |>
  mutate(
    GrossMonthly = as.numeric(GrossMonthly),
    TakeHomePay = GrossMonthly * 0.8,
    MonthlySaving = TakeHomePay * 0.35,
    YearlySaving = MonthlySaving * 12,
    YearsInGroup = case_when(
      AgeGroup == "15 - 19" ~ 1,
      AgeGroup == "60 & Over" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 5
    ),
    SavingsWithoutInvesting = round(YearlySaving * YearsInGroup, 0),
    CumulativeSavings = cumsum(round(YearlySaving * YearsInGroup, 0))
  ) |>
  filter(row_number() <= which(AgeGroup == "60 & Over"))

# Add compounding
cumulative_with_interest <- numeric(nrow(df_income))
interest_rate <- 0.04
total <- 0
for (i in 1:nrow(df_income)) {
  for (year in 1:df_income$YearsInGroup[i]) {
    total <- (total + df_income$YearlySaving[i]) * (1 + interest_rate)
  }
  cumulative_with_interest[i] <- round(total, 0)
}
df_income$CumulativeWithInterest <- cumulative_with_interest
```

```{r}
# Clean saving rate data
quarter_labels <- as.character(unlist(df_raw[10, ]))
quarter_labels[1] <- "DataSeries"
colnames(df_raw) <- make.names(quarter_labels, unique = TRUE)
df_clean <- df_raw[-c(1:10), ]
valid_cols <- colnames(df_clean)[!is.na(colnames(df_clean)) & colnames(df_clean) != ""]
df_clean <- df_clean[, valid_cols]

df_saving <- df_clean |>
  filter(str_detect(DataSeries, "Saving Rate")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -DataSeries, names_to = "Quarter", values_to = "SavingRate") |>
  select(Quarter, SavingRate) |>
  mutate(
    Quarter = str_remove(Quarter, "^X"),
    SavingRate = str_replace_all(SavingRate, ",", "."),
    SavingRate = as.numeric(str_extract(SavingRate, "[0-9.]+"))
  )

df_yearly_avg <- df_saving |>
  mutate(Year = str_extract(Quarter, "^\\d{4}")) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(AverageSavingRate = round(mean(SavingRate, na.rm = TRUE), 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(Year))
```

```{r}
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

# Prep variables
df_income <- df_income |>
  mutate(
    AgeGroup = as.character(AgeGroup),
    YearlyBonus = YearlySaving * YearsInGroup,
    BaseSavings = CumulativeSavings - YearlyBonus,
    TakeHome5Y = TakeHomePay * 12 * 5
  )

# Data to JS
take_home_pay <- toJSON(df_income$TakeHomePay)
years_in_group <- toJSON(df_income$YearsInGroup)
age_groups <- toJSON(df_income$AgeGroup)

# Sliders
sliders <- tags$div(
  style = "margin-bottom:20px;",
  tags$div(
    tags$label("Savings Rate (%): "),
    tags$input(type = "range", id = "savings_rate", min = "0", max = "100", value = "35"),
    tags$span(id = "savings_rate_value", "35")
  ),
  tags$div(
    tags$label("Interest Rate (%): "),
    tags$input(type = "range", id = "interest_rate", min = "0", max = "10", step = "0.1", value = "4"),
    tags$span(id = "interest_rate_value", "4")
  )
)

# JavaScript chart update
js_code <- tags$script(HTML("
  function updateChart() {
    var savingsRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('savings_rate').value) / 100;
    var interestRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('interest_rate').value) / 100;

    var yearlySaving = takeHomePay.map(pay => pay * 12 * savingsRate);
    var baseSavings = [], bonusSavings = [], bonusBase = [], withInterest = [], takeHome5Y = [], interestGained = [];
    let cumNoInterest = 0, cumWithInterest = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < yearlySaving.length; i++) {
      let bonus = yearlySaving[i] * yearsInGroup[i];
      baseSavings.push(cumNoInterest);
      bonusBase.push(cumNoInterest);
      bonusSavings.push(bonus);
      cumNoInterest += bonus;

      for (let y = 0; y < yearsInGroup[i]; y++) {
        cumWithInterest = (cumWithInterest + yearlySaving[i]) * (1 + interestRate);
      }
      withInterest.push(Math.round(cumWithInterest));
      interestGained.push(Math.round(cumWithInterest - cumNoInterest));
      takeHome5Y.push(takeHomePay[i] * 12 * 5);
    }

    Plotly.react('plot', [
      {
        x: ageGroups,
        y: baseSavings,
        name: 'Total Savings (No Interest applied)',
        type: 'bar',
        marker: { color: 'lightgreen' },
        offsetgroup: '1',
        legendgroup: 'NoInterest',
        hoverinfo: 'y'
      },
      {
        x: ageGroups,
        y: bonusSavings,
        base: bonusBase,
        name: 'New Savings in Age Group',
        type: 'bar',
        marker: { color: 'darkgreen' },
        offsetgroup: '1',
        legendgroup: 'NoInterest',
        hoverinfo: 'y'
      },
      {
        x: ageGroups,
        y: baseSavings.map((v, i) => v + bonusSavings[i]),
        name: 'Cumulative Savings (No Interest)',
        type: 'bar',
        marker: { color: 'purple' },
        offsetgroup: '2',
        legendgroup: 'WithInterest',
        hoverinfo: 'skip',
        showlegend: false
      },
      {
        x: ageGroups,
        y: interestGained,
        base: baseSavings.map((v, i) => v + bonusSavings[i]),
        name: 'Total Savings (With Compound Interest)',
        type: 'bar',
        marker: { color: 'purple' },
        offsetgroup: '2',
        legendgroup: 'WithInterest',
        hoverinfo: 'y'
      },
      {
        x: ageGroups,
        y: takeHome5Y,
        name: 'Estimated 5-Year Take-home Pay',
        type: 'scatter',
        mode: 'lines+markers',
        line: { color: 'orange', width: 3 },
        marker: { symbol: 'circle', size: 7, color: 'violet' },
        legendgroup: 'Line'
      }
    ], {
      barmode: 'group',
      title: 'Savings Comparison: No Interest (Stacked) vs With Interest',
      xaxis: { title: 'Age Group' },
      yaxis: { title: 'Amount (SGD)' },
      hovermode: 'x unified',
      legend: { x: 0.05, y: 0.95 }
    });
  }

  document.getElementById('savings_rate').addEventListener('input', function () {
    document.getElementById('savings_rate_value').textContent = this.value;
    updateChart();
  });

  document.getElementById('interest_rate').addEventListener('input', function () {
    document.getElementById('interest_rate_value').textContent = this.value;
    updateChart();
  });

  setTimeout(updateChart, 300);
"))

# Initial plot (fallback)
p <- plot_ly(df_income, x = ~AgeGroup) %>%
  add_bars(y = ~BaseSavings, name = "Total Savings (No Interest applied)", marker = list(color = "lightgreen")) %>%
  add_bars(y = ~YearlyBonus, base = ~BaseSavings, name = "New Savings in Age Group", marker = list(color = "darkgreen")) %>%
  add_bars(y = ~CumulativeWithInterest, name = "Total Savings (With Interest)", marker = list(color = "purple")) %>%
  add_trace(y = ~TakeHome5Y, name = "Estimated 5-Year Take-home Pay", type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            line = list(color = "orange", width = 3), marker = list(symbol = "circle", size = 7, color = "violet"))



```

```{r hidden-plot, include=FALSE}
plot_ly(df_income, x = ~AgeGroup, y = ~CumulativeSavings, type = "bar")
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# Render output
browsable(tagList(
  sliders,
  tags$div(id = "plot", style = "height:600px; width: 700px;"),
  tags$script(HTML(paste0("Plotly.newPlot('plot', ", plotly_json(p, jsonedit = FALSE), ");"))),
  tags$script(HTML(paste0(
    "var takeHomePay = ", take_home_pay, ";",
    "var yearsInGroup = ", years_in_group, ";",
    "var ageGroups = ", age_groups, ";"
  ))),
  js_code
))

```
